title: spec + docs + skills: SkillSchema.tools is no longer inert once #32767 lands — the skill is offered on an MCP connection only when every bound tool is served
body:
domain:server#6 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cz8zK9vJDPeeVKJ4XP

Filing gate: ② a declared contract text the code no longer honours, found by the contract review of PR #32880 (#32767), finding F4 (comment 6838062944). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

## What

PR #32880 makes `SkillSchema.tools` decide whether a skill is offered on the HTTP MCP door: `prompts/list` and `prompts/get` project a skill only when the connection serves every tool it binds (`action_*` entries count as served when `run_action` is served). The published prose still says the binding is inert in the open framework:

- `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts`: the class JSDoc ("instructions served everywhere", "inert here"), the `tools` JSDoc, and its `.describe()` string.
- `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` (around line 242).
- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` (around line 383).

## Expected

Each says what the binding now does: the skill's instructions are offered on an MCP connection only when that connection serves every bound tool, and an `action_NAME` entry is served through `run_action`. Nothing else in those files changes.

## Order

Lands in the same release as PR #32880, after it merges (`Blocked-by: #32767`). The `skills/**` part is a published skill and takes the contract tier for build and review; the `packages/spec` part is a describe-text change on a published schema.

Blocked-by: #32767

## Reader

The spec lane (`skill.zod.ts`), with the skills lane for `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`; docs follow the surface they record.

## Duplicate check

`is:issue SkillSchema.tools inert` and `is:issue skill tools binding prompts served` on objectstack: no open card tracks this prose.
